- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] In the comic strip, Hobbes suggests inventing a machine that turns thoughts into reality, which excites Calvin.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Calvin and Hobbes discuss the potential of their invention, including wishing for world peace and an end to hunger and poverty.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] The comic strip continues with Calvin and Hobbes in the garage, working on the machine, discussing the need for a mind-reading device and a 3D printer.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] After several hours, they finish the machine, and Calvin tests it by wishing for a sandwich, which successfully appears.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] The comic strip concludes with Calvin and Hobbes excited about using their invention to make the world a better place.
